Shanghai Containerized Freight Index in 2025
Freight Rate outlook 
2025Overall Market Trend
 Ocean freight rates continue to normalize after the post-COVID peak. Both the SCFI
(container rates) and BDI (dry bulk rates) show a downward or stabilizing trend moving into
2025–2026 due to increasing vessel supply and softening global trade momentum.
Key Observations
•SCFI: Decreased from 2,470 in 2024 to an average of 1,582 in 2025,(-35%) with forecasts
of 1,400–1,900 in 2025F and 1,300–1,800 in 2026F.
•BDI: Moderately volatile but overall stable, forecast at 1,100–1,600 in 2025F and 1,000–1,500
in 2026F.

We Deliver Values and Smart SolutionWICE Sustainability 
20WICE is advancing its Net Zero 2050 ambition by
strengthening both internal operations and external
collaboration.
Internally, we improve efficiency and reduce emissions
through initiatives such as 100% electric forklifts, advanced
WMS, ISO 14064-1:2018 GHG certification, and the use of
solar rooftops to support long-term sustainable operations.
Externally, we expand our green ecosystem with customers
and partners. The 2025 ESG Symposium raised ESG
awareness and sparked pilot programs on ESG training,
knowledge-sharing, and sustainability consultation. As
customer expectations evolve, WICE continues to integrate
sustainability into our logistics solutions.
Together, these initiatives reinforce WICE’s commitment to
green logistics and long-term sustainable growth.NET
